description.value: Fatburger Ladner is a casual burger restaurant that cooks every meal to order using fresh-never-frozen Alberta Angus beef, with a menu spanning burgers, chicken tenders, veggie options, hand-scooped milkshakes, and house-made onion rings. Part of the Fatburger Canada chain (proudly Canadian-owned since 2005), this location offers both dine-in and takeout with no drive-through. A touring cyclist stopping in the Delta–Ladner area would find a reliable hot meal with vegetarian choices available.
